components.purpose: Top hero section covering the request for two different headlines to A/B test — uses its ExperimentKey and nested Variants grid to hold the Control headline plus a second headline variant.
Single testimonial section placed after the hero, linking to one TestimonialItem (the plural 'Testimonials' component was avoided since only a single testimonial was requested).

Contact form at the bottom of the page for lead capture — a dedicated contact form component, chosen over the generic/legacy FormBuilder and AgilityFormBuilder components which are hidden and not intended for new pages.
